webhooks.detail: Webhooks API (POST /api/v2/webhooks) subscribes to org, user, help center, community events; ticket events via trigger/automation-connected webhooks

evidence.quote: Subscribe the webhook to one or more Zendesk events.

sandbox.detail: Free 14-day trial account for developers; sponsored (non-expiring, up to 5 agents) accounts for Marketplace partners; customer devs use own sandboxes

evidence.quote: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.

rate_limits.summary: Per-minute by plan: Team 200, Professional 400, Enterprise 700 (High Volume add-on 2500); 429 + Retry-After

evidence.quote: If the rate limit is exceeded, the API responds with a 429 Too Many Requests status code.
Made the OpenAPI specifications for the Ticketing and Help Center APIs available as OAS file downloads.
